description: In src/mdn.rs handle_mdn_send (lines 190-242), the CRLF injection check covers: subject, text_body, reporting_ua, final_recipient, and extension_fields. The Mdn struct also contains mdn_gateway (doc: server-set on parse) and original_message_id (doc: server-set on parse). These fields are on the same Mdn struct used for both send and parse. A client sending a malicious MDN/send request could include mdn_gateway or original_message_id with CRLF. The handler does not check them. The spec says they are server-set (ignored on send), but the server does not strip them — they pass through serde deserialization into the Mdn handed to send_mdns. Either validate+reject these fields on send, or document that server-set fields are ignored/stripped before processing.
title: mdn handle_mdn_send: CRLF check misses server-set fields (mdn_gateway, original_message_id)
